text: 把手放到镜头前吧。
翻一下手，手背对着镜头。
顺着圆圈慢慢找。
就是这里，轻轻稳住。
很好，就这样稳稳按住。
松开手指，放松呼吸。
没关系，慢慢回到穴位上。
保持得很好，完成了。
用另一只手的指尖，在虚线圈附近按一按找找。
有点远了，回到虚线圈附近。
按住不动一小会儿。
很好 — 现在可以保存这个位置了。
把对方的手放进画面吧。
把对方的手翻过来，手背对着镜头。
用你的指尖，在对方手上的虚线圈附近按一按找找。
翻一下手，手心对着镜头。
把对方的手翻过来，手心对着镜头。
已记住你的位置 — 圆圈就在那里。
中渚。手背朝上。沿无名指与小指指节之间的缝向下滑，指节后方能摸到两根手骨之间的小凹陷。摸到两骨之间那个略酸的小凹陷了吗？
内关。掌心朝上。三横指并拢放在腕横纹上方，第三指外侧缘下、两条肌腱之间即是（手掌微握时肌腱会浮起）。指尖下摸到那两条肌腱了吗？
外关。前臂背面朝上。腕背横纹上三横指，两骨之间正中 — 与掌面的内关正相对。在腕上三横指、两骨正中了吗？
劳宫。掌心朝上。把中指弯向掌心，指尖触到掌心处即是 — 就在手掌正中。指尖正落在掌心中央了吗？
神门。掌心朝上。沿腕横纹向小指侧摸，会碰到一颗豌豆大的小圆骨 — 穴位就在它前方的横纹上。摸到掌根那颗小圆骨了吗？
后溪。轻轻握拳。在手的小指侧，找到掌横纹的尽头 — 穴位就在指节后方、手心和手背肤色交界的地方。摸到手侧掌纹尽头的位置了吗？
液门。手背朝上。找到无名指与小指之间的指蹼，向手腕方向滑一点，落在两指分开处的柔软凹陷里。指蹼后方那个略酸的软凹陷，摸到了吗？
少府。掌心向上。轻轻握拳，小指指尖点到掌心的位置就是它，在第四、五掌骨之间。小指指尖落到的那个柔软凹陷？
鱼际。掌心向上。沿拇指根部的隆起（鱼际）找到中点，正在手掌与手背肤色交界处。鱼际隆起中段、肤色交界上的酸胀点？
太渊。掌心向上。腕横纹拇指侧能摸到脉搏，穴位就在脉搏旁靠拇指的小凹陷里 — 按在凹陷上，不要压住脉搏。脉搏旁边那个小凹陷？
阳溪。拇指翘起（像竖大拇指）。拇指根部会绷起两条筋，穴位在两筋之间、靠近腕横纹的凹窝里。两筋之间那个三角形凹窝？
腕骨。手背朝上，看小指侧。从第五掌骨底向手腕方向滑，快到腕骨时会落进一个凹陷。手掌外缘、腕骨前方的凹陷？
印堂。沿眉毛摸到两眉头的内侧端，穴位就在两者正中间、鼻梁上方的骨面上。两眉之间鼻根上方那个平坦的骨面点？
太阳。找到眉梢与外眼角，取两者连线的中点，再向耳朵方向滑约一拇指宽，落进太阳穴的柔软凹陷。太阳穴那个向后约一拇指宽的柔软凹陷？
百会。从两侧耳尖向上摸，两条线在头顶正中相交处就是它，正中线上略有凹陷。头顶正中那个略凹的位置？
四神聪。先找到头顶正中的百会（两耳尖向上连线的交点），再在它的前、后、左、右各约一拇指宽处各取一点，共四处。用指尖依次轻轻停放。头顶百会周围一圈的四个柔软点，摸到了吗？
膻中。在胸骨上，两乳头连线的中点，正中线上 — 是骨面上的平坦点，不在软组织上。胸骨正中那个略酸的点？
俞府。沿锁骨下缘向胸骨中线滑，停在离中线约两个拇指宽处，锁骨下方的凹陷里。锁骨下缘的那个凹陷？
中脘。在上腹正中线上，肚脐与胸骨下端的正中间。肚脐与胸骨下端正中那个柔软的位置？
天枢。从肚脐中心向两侧各量约两个拇指宽，与肚脐齐平。与肚脐齐平、旁开约两拇指宽的位置？
曲池。屈肘成直角。肘横纹在拇指侧到头，穴位就在横纹外侧尽头的凹陷处。肘横纹外端那个凹陷？
尺泽。掌心向上，微屈肘。摸到肘横纹中央的大筋，穴位在其拇指侧的凹陷里。大筋拇指侧的凹陷？
阳池。手腕背面朝上。从无名指根部沿腕背横纹摸，穴位是横纹上的一个软凹陷、在肌腱靠小指侧。摸到腕背横纹上的软凹陷了吗？
大陵。掌心朝上。穴位在腕掌横纹正中，两条肌腱之间的凹陷处（手掌微握时肌腱浮起）。在腕横纹正中的凹陷里了吗？
足三里。屈膝而坐。四指并拢放在膝眼下方，在第四指下缘、距胫骨前嵴外侧约一横指的肌肉上。胫骨旁肌肉上那个略酸的结实点？
阳陵泉。屈膝而坐。摸到小腿外侧膝下的圆形骨突，穴位在其前下方的凹陷中。骨突前下方的凹陷？
血海。屈膝而坐。用对侧手掌盖住膝盖、手指朝大腿方向，拇指所指处即是，在大腿内侧肌肉隆起上。膝内上方肌肉隆起处的酸胀点？
梁丘。屈膝而坐。在髌骨外上角上方约两个拇指宽处，大腿外侧肌肉的凹陷中。髌骨外上角上方的结实凹陷？
犊鼻。屈膝。髌骨下方、髌韧带两侧会出现两个凹陷（膝眼），穴位是外侧那个。髌骨下方外侧的那个凹陷？
太冲。足背。沿拇趾与第二趾之间的缝向脚踝方向滑，手指停在两骨相接处的凹陷里。此处有时能摸到脉搏，请轻按。两骨相接处的那个凹陷？
内庭。足背。找到第二、三趾之间的趾蹼，向后滑一点，落进小凹陷。趾蹼后方的小凹陷？
涌泉。足底。蜷起脚趾，足底前三分之一处出现的最深凹陷就是它。蜷趾时足底最深的那个凹陷？
太溪。内踝。摸到内踝尖，向跟腱方向平移，穴位在内踝尖与跟腱之间的凹陷中，与踝尖齐平。内踝与跟腱之间的凹陷？
Bring your hand into view.
Turn your hand over — back to the camera.
Ease over toward the ring.
That's it — settle in.
Good — keep that steady press.
Release — and breathe.
No rush — ease back onto the point.
Nicely held — all done.
Feel around the dashed ring with your other fingertip.
A little far — closer to the dashed ring.
Hold the press still a moment.
Good — you can save this spot now.
Bring their hand into view.
Turn their hand over — back to the camera.
Feel around the dashed ring on their hand with your fingertip.
Turn your hand over — palm to the camera.
Turn their hand over — palm to the camera.
Saved — the ring now sits on your spot.

Zhongzhu. Back of the hand up. Slide a fingertip down the gap between your ring and little-finger knuckles; just behind them you drop into a small dip between the two hand bones. Feel the small tender dip between the bones?

Neiguan. Palm up. Lay three fingers across the forearm just above the wrist crease; the spot is under the far edge of your third finger, between the two tendons that rise when you cup your hand. Feel the two tendons under your fingertip?

Waiguan. Back of the forearm up. Measure three fingers above the wrist crease, midway between the two forearm bones — directly opposite Neiguan on the palm side. Midway between the two forearm bones, three fingers up?
Laogong. Palm up. Curl your middle finger in until its tip touches your palm — the spot is right where the tip lands, in the centre of the palm. Fingertip resting in the centre of your palm?

Shenmen. Palm up. Run a finger along the wrist crease toward the little-finger side until you meet a small pea-shaped bone; the spot sits just before it, on the crease. Feel the little round bone at the base of the palm?

Houxi. Make a loose fist. On the little-finger edge of your hand, find where the main palm crease ends — the spot is just behind the knuckle, where palm skin meets back-of-hand skin. Feel where the crease ends on the side of your hand?

Yemen. Back of the hand up. Find the web between your ring and little fingers, then slide just behind it toward the wrist — you land in a soft dip where the two fingers part. A soft, slightly tender dip just behind the web?
Shaofu. Palm up. Make a loose fist — where the tip of your little finger touches the palm is the spot, between the fourth and fifth hand bones. The soft hollow your little fingertip lands on?

Yuji. Palm up. Follow the fleshy mound at the base of your thumb to its midpoint, right where the pale palm skin meets the back-of-hand skin. The tender middle of the thumb mound, on the colour border?

Taiyuan. Palm up. At the thumb side of the wrist crease you can feel a pulse — the point sits in the small hollow right beside it, toward the thumb. Rest on the hollow, not on the pulse. The small hollow beside the pulse?
Yangxi. Lift your thumb as if hitchhiking. Two tendons stand up at its base — the point is in the hollow between them at the wrist crease. The triangular hollow between the two tendons?

Wangu. Back of the hand up, little-finger side. Slide from the base of the little-finger hand bone toward the wrist — you drop into a dip just before the wrist bone. The dip on the edge of the hand, just before the wrist?

Yintang. Run a fingertip along your brow to the inner end of each eyebrow — the point is the flat spot midway between them, on the bone just above the bridge of the nose. The flat spot on the bone between your eyebrows?

Taiyang. Find the outer end of your eyebrow and the outer corner of your eye; go to the midpoint between them, then slide back toward your ear about a thumb-width into the soft hollow of the temple. The soft hollow at the temple, a thumb-width back?
Baihui. Run a finger up from the top of each ear until the two lines meet on the crown — the point is where they meet, in a slight dip on the midline. The slight dip at the very top of the head?

Sishencong. Find the crown point first (where lines up from both ear tips meet), then feel one thumb-width forward, back, left and right of it — four spots in a small ring. Rest a fingertip lightly on each in turn. Four soft spots in a ring around the crown?
Shanzhong. On the breastbone, midway between the nipples, on the centre line — a flat spot on the bone rather than on soft tissue. A slightly tender spot on the breastbone centre line?
Shufu. Find your collarbone and slide along its lower edge toward the centre; stop about two thumb-widths out from the midline, in the hollow under the bone. The hollow just under the collarbone?
Zhongwan. On the centre line of your upper belly, midway between your navel and the lower tip of the breastbone. The soft midpoint between navel and breastbone?
Tianshu. Two thumb-widths out to the side from the centre of your navel, level with it. Level with the navel, a couple of thumb-widths out?
Quchi. Bend your elbow to a right angle. The crease ends on the thumb side — the point sits in the dip right at that outer end. The dip at the outer end of the elbow crease?
Chize. Palm up, elbow slightly bent. Feel the big tendon in the middle of the elbow crease — the point is in the dip just to the thumb side of it. The dip beside the tendon, on the thumb side?

Yangchi. Back of the wrist up. Follow the wrist crease from the base of your ring finger; the spot is a soft hollow on the crease, just to the little-finger side of the tendon. Feel the soft hollow on the back of the wrist?
Daling. Palm up. The spot is in the middle of the wrist crease, in the dip between the two tendons that rise when you cup your hand. In the centre dip of the wrist crease?

Zusanli. Sit with the knee bent. Lay four fingers together below the outer dip of your kneecap — at the lowest finger, move one finger-width out from the shin crest onto the muscle. A firm, slightly sore spot on the muscle beside the shin bone?

Yanglingquan. Sit with the knee bent. Feel the small round bone bump on the outer lower leg just below the knee — the point is in the dip just in front of and below it. The dip below the round bone bump?

Xuehai. Sit with the knee bent. Cup your opposite palm over the kneecap, fingers up the thigh — the point is under your thumb, on the bulge of the inner thigh muscle. The tender bulge of muscle above the inner knee?
Liangqiu. Sit with the knee bent. About two thumb-widths above the outer top corner of the kneecap, in the dip on the outer thigh muscle. A firm dip above the outer corner of the kneecap?
Dubi. Bend the knee. Two dimples appear under the kneecap, either side of the tendon — the point is the outer one. The outer dimple under the kneecap?

Taichong. Top of the foot. Slide a fingertip back along the groove between your big toe and second toe — the point is where the two foot bones meet and your finger stops. Rest gently; a pulse can sometimes be felt here. The hollow where the two foot bones meet?
Neiting. Top of the foot. Find the web between your second and third toes and slide just behind it into the small dip. The small dip just behind the toe web?
Yongquan. Sole of the foot. Curl your toes — the deepest hollow that appears in the front third of the sole is the spot. The deepest hollow when you curl your toes?

Taixi. Inner ankle. Feel the tip of the inner ankle bone, then slide straight back toward the Achilles tendon — the point is in the hollow between them, level with the bone tip. The hollow between ankle bone and tendon?
